svg.text: How one hand with a roll-bayonet grip, one turning heated hub and loose ware prepare, cook, serve and clean.
6 motion actuators: X, Z, Y, roll (hand) + T, S (hub)
2 dynamic seals (Z band, Y band) · roll and hub canned, no seal

g.text: 1 Roll-bayonet grip: stub and sleeve (60° lock)
1 push the sleeve 35 mm onto the stub along +y
2 roll +60°: the pins run into the J-slots
3 lift: load cell checks mass and moment ±10 %
Every pot, tray, tool and box carries the same stub Ø 22.
Push in, roll +60° while the item rests: a PEEK detent clicks.
Canned roll coupling, no seal · 10 Nm · lift ≤ 6 kg
2 Turning hub with induction ring coil (section)
Stirring: ring coil on 2.5 kW, hung scraper, T 20 rpm
Kneading: hung roller, T 60–100 rpm, coil off
T turns any vessel through a closed pocket: magnets, no seal.
The ring coil round the pocket heats the pot while T stirs.
T 25 Nm, 0–500 rpm · S 6000 rpm · coil 2.5 kW · ±2 g
3 Press cup on the hub: dicing upward through a grid
T turns the screw base; the piston pushes the food UP
through a bought dicer grid; the spatula sweeps the cubes off.
Grids 6 / 10 mm, ricer 3 mm · ≈ 3 kN · loose ware, washed
4 Generic produce module: no single-purpose device
G1: the roll turns the item, Z presses it on the sprung blade.
G2: skin-down on the piston, flesh passes, skin and stone stay.
Shoes 1 / 2.5 / 5 mm + rasp · ricer 3 mm · waste → chute
5 Dish carrier flip and the wash well
The carrier is rolled 180° over the chute: scraps fall out.
One well with bought dishwasher parts washes ware and dishes.
12–15 min a load · rinse ≥ 82 °C, 60 s · clean in 50–60 min
heated hub: ring coil 1.8 kW, T spins
3 cook on the heated hub, 90 s
4 partner pan set on rim to rim, hook engages
5 lift 50 mm, roll the pair 180° in 0.8 s
6 set down, empty pan off; 60 s more
One fast turn of the heated hub spreads the batter thin.
Two pans hook rim to rim; the roll turns the pair 180°.
Ring coil 1.8 kW · flip in 0.8 s · 8 pancakes ≈ 30 min
